one_line: origin/main HEAD ded132904 carries the felix W22/D131 1 MiB display cap; it is the ONLY semantic delta vs the worktree copy the survey read (confirmed by full file diff, 136 lines, all in the cap machinery). classify_tail/fence_kind/portabledoc_kind/stable_boundary/skeleton are byte-identical worktree<->origin/main.

clauses: advance_streaming(nil, delta) -> advance_streaming(%{text:"", stable_html:nil, stable_len:0, capped:false}, delta)
advance_streaming(%{capped:true}=state, _delta) -> state  (terminal: further deltas are no-ops, neither accumulator nor re-render can grow)

advance_streaming(state, delta): text=state.text<>delta; if byte_size(text)>max_streaming_display_bytes() -> freeze_streaming(state, text); else advance boundary=stable_boundary(text); if boundary>state.stable_len re-render prefix through render_paper_html and bump stable_len, else return state unchanged

freeze_streaming/2.behavior: ONE last render up to the last stable balanced-fence boundary (if any beyond current stable_len); text is TRUNCATED to stable_len bytes (streaming_tail/1 then yields "" so the template shows only the honest marker, never a partial tail); capped:true set. If NO balanced boundary exists yet (one giant unbroken block) the bubble shows only the marker.

max_streaming_display_bytes/0.provenance: felix W22 (charter D131 of the GUI-remake/felix charter, NOT the chat-tui charter -- chat-tui charter tops out at D74 on origin/main); task-felix-w22-chatlive-stream-display-cap; paper felix-pristine-wave-22-2026-07-23 names the exact seam 'chat_live.ex advance_streaming does uncapped state.text <> delta at the sink'

logic: fence_count = count of literal ``` in tail; if ODD -> split at the LAST ``` occurrence, prose=before, fence=from that ``` to end, kind=fence_kind(fence)
else if forming_table?(tail) (trimmed tail starts with '|') -> {:component,"table",""}
else if trimmed tail starts with '>' -> {:component,"callout",""}

fence_kind/1.logic: first line after ``` trimmed: "mermaid"->"diagram"; "portabledoc"->portabledoc_kind(rest); anything else (incl. plain ```elixir etc.)->"code"

portabledoc_kind/1.logic: regex "type":"([\\w-]+)" on the partial JSON fence body: chart|heatmap->"chart"; stat|stats->"stats"; table->"table"; callout->"callout"; divider->"code"; any other named type or no match->"block"

stable_boundary/1.logic:
find the LAST 

 occurrence (scanning matches reversed) whose preceding prefix has an EVEN count of ``` (balanced_fences?); returns that boundary offset, or 0 if none/no 

 at all. This is a full O(n) re-scan of the WHOLE text on every delta (called out in the pre-cap comment as the compounding cost the byte cap exists to bound).

skeleton_component.shape_per_kind: chart=6 bars flex row; stats=3 flex tiles; table=3x3 grid of shape divs; (diagram/callout/code/block fall through to a generic shimmer -- verified only chart/stats/table get bespoke shapes at chat_live.ex:3859-3900, remaining kinds share the default branch)
skeleton_component.css_class: bp-chat-skel, data-skel={kind} attribute is the test hook
skeleton_component.location: chat_live.ex:3859-3900ish (defp skeleton/1, private HEEx function component)

order: 2. IF @streaming[:capped]: render ONLY the honest marker div (data-streaming-capped, text 'live preview truncated — the full response arrives on completion') and STOP -- no tail/skeleton markup at all

3. ELSE: case classify_tail(streaming_tail(@streaming)) of {:text,tail} -> plain pre-wrap div with a dim streaming cursor '▌' appended; {:component,kind,prose} -> prose div (if non-empty) THEN <.skeleton kind={kind}/>

settle_path_D9.confirms: on turn completion, each text block appends via append_message(acc,:assistant,text, html: render_paper_html(text), ...) -- the SAME render_paper_html(markdown)=FromMarkdown.blocks()|>Render.render_blocks(%{style::article}) used for the streaming stable_html prefix. This is the D9 'settle path stays SOLE truth' anchor: the final HTML the ct-bl-stream-rich Go port must byte-match is produced by the identical function used mid-stream, just over the FULL text instead of a stable prefix.
settle_path_D9.cap_independence: advance_streaming's cap comment explicitly names this as the reason truncating the LIVE bubble loses zero durable data: :1380-ish full-frame append is untouched by the display cap (display-only accumulator, never the durable sink).
